name: contentasoft-ai-video-enhancer
description: AI Video Enhancer Studio for Windows: upscaling, stabilizing, denoising and frame-rate conversion of videos on an NVIDIA RTX GPU, on local files.

interface.longDescription: Upscale, stabilize, denoise and smooth videos on your Windows PC with your NVIDIA RTX GPU. AI Video Enhancer Studio is a Windows desktop app for upscaling, stabilizing, denoising and frame-rate conversion of videos on an NVIDIA RTX GPU; this skill teaches the agent its command-line tool (aivideoenhancer), so you ask in plain words and the work runs on your own PC, on your own files, with nothing uploaded. It needs AI Video Enhancer Studio installed (https://www.contenta-software.com/aivideoenhancer/download.php). In Codex the agent runs the commands for you; in ChatGPT it tells you which command to run. Support: bruno@contenta-software.com
defaultPrompt: Upscale this old 480p family video to 1080p and reduce the noise.
Stabilize this shaky drone clip and raise it to 60 fps.
Pull 12 still frames from this video as thumbnails.
